purpose: Fill remaining low-photo taxa using iNaturalist, GBIF occurrence media, and Wikimedia Commons review links.
source_scope: Exact species-level iNaturalist observations plus GBIF still-image occurrence records and Commons file pages matched by species-name text; preserve source type, underlying photo links, taxon-match warning, attribution, and licence claims.
copy_policy: Archive only photo-level CC0 or CC BY iNaturalist candidate files; keep GBIF and Commons media pages, all other rights, and unknown rights as source links for owner review.
